papers.title: Nash Equilibria in Auctions with Pacing Strategies: Complexity and Inefficiency
papers.titleZh: 带节制策略的拍卖中的纳什均衡：复杂性与低效率
papers.abstract: We introduce and study Auctions with Pacing Strategies (APS) games, a full-information model in which utility-maximizing bidders compete across many simultaneous first-price auctions, each choosing a single pacing multiplier that uniformly scales their values into bids. We settle three central questions. First, we show that there are instances that admit no approximate pure Nash equilibria. Then, we prove that the problem of deciding whether an APS game admits an (approximate) equilibrium is NP-complete in general, but can be solved in polynomial time if either the number of bidders or the number of items is fixed. Finally, when an equilibrium does exist, we characterize its inefficiency exactly, showing that both the Price of Anarchy and the Price of Stability equal $\frac{e}{e-1}$.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在现代广告拍卖中，简单的节制策略会导致战略困境？随着第一价格拍卖成为主流，广告主不再能通过真实报价获利，必须主动压低出价。然而在海量实时拍卖中，逐场优化不现实，实践中普遍采用单一乘数来统一调整所有竞价，即‘节制策略’。这种简化虽便于执行，却使各拍卖相互耦合，引发复杂的策略互动。本文追问：这类博弈是否存在稳定状态（均衡），能否高效计算，以及一旦存在，其社会福利表现如何。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者构建了一个完全信息博弈模型，称为APS游戏：多个效用最大化的竞拍者在多个并行的第一价格拍卖中竞争，每人只能选择一个全局节制乘数，将其价值线性缩放为出价。赢家支付自己的出价，效用为赢得物品的总价值减去总支出。模型关注纯策略纳什均衡及其近似版本，允许一定的偏离收益。关键设定在于策略空间被压缩至一维，尽管没有预算约束，但由此产生的战略依赖足以制造复杂性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文彻底回答了三个核心问题：首先，纯纳什均衡可能根本不存在，即使允许一定近似，非存在性也随物品数量线性增长；其次，判断均衡是否存在是NP完全问题，但在竞拍者或物品数量固定时可在多项式时间内解决；最后，当均衡存在时，其效率被精确刻画——无论选择哪个均衡，最坏情况下的社会福利损失由价格波动决定，且价格波动与价格稳定性均等于e/(e-1)，意味着任何均衡至少能实现最优福利的(1-1/e)比例。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过巧妙的归约与放大技术证明复杂性：从精确覆盖问题出发构造一个硬核实例，再利用复制引理将常数间隙放大为几乎线性的不可判定边界。对于存在性分析，采用阈值排序与前缀效用的思想，将最佳响应转化为有限个线性条件。效率分析则借鉴平滑性框架，设计一个基于[0,1-1/e]上特定分布的随机偏离，从而导出紧的价格波动上界，并通过构造渐进达到该边界的实例完成下界证明。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文聚焦无预算的理想化设定，而现实中预算约束才是节制策略的主要动因，这使得结果更偏向揭示内在战略复杂性而非直接指导实践。此外，NP完全性依赖于精心构造的实例，实际中均衡可能更常见。尽管如此，该文价值极高：其模型简洁有力，揭示了节制行为本身的博弈本质；证明技术融合组合构造与连续优化，极具启发性；对效率的紧刻画也为后续研究提供了基准。最值得细读的是其清晰的问题提炼与优雅的技术整合。

papers.title: Settling the Complexity Landscape of Multi-Agent Contracts with Binary Actions
papers.titleZh: 解决二元动作下多智能体合约的复杂性图景
papers.abstract: We study the computational complexity of optimal contract design in the multi-agent binary-action model, focusing on gross-substitutes reward functions and related classes. While additive rewards admit an FPTAS and general submodular rewards admit only constant-factor approximation, the complexity within the intermediate class of gross substitutes has remained largely open. We uncover a fine-grained approximation landscape within this class. We first show that the optimal contract problem is APX-complete even for OXS rewards - a strict subclass of gross substitutes rewards, ruling out a PTAS for gross substitutes unless $\mathsf{P}=\mathsf{NP}$. In contrast, for weighted matroid rank functions (WMRFs) - another natural subclass of gross substitutes - we obtain an EPTAS and show that no randomized FPTAS exists in general. We further identify the special case of partition (weighted) matroid rank functions, for which we obtain an FPTAS. This stands in contrast to the multi-agent multi-action setting, where no PTAS exists even for unweighted partition matroid rank functions. Finally, we consider the broader class of ultra reward functions. While ultra rewards retain the tractability of gross substitutes in a related combinatorial contract model with a single agent, we show a sharp contrast in the multi-agent model: no polynomial-time randomized algorithm using value queries can achieve a $2^{o(n)}$-approximation in expectation. Together, our results reveal several qualitatively distinct computational regimes within and beyond gross substitutes, and identify submodularity as a crucial ingredient for the approximability of multi-agent contracts.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么多智能体合约的设计如此困难？本文聚焦于一个基本模型：一个委托人希望激励多个代理人付出努力完成项目，但无法观测其行为，只能根据项目成败进行奖励。已有研究表明，当奖励函数为加性时问题较易，子模时仅能常数近似，而介于两者之间的“替代品”（gross substitutes, GS）类长期不清楚其近似边界。本文旨在精细刻画GS及其子类的计算复杂性景观。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型中有一组代理人，每人决定是否付出成本来提升项目成功概率，该概率由一个集合函数f决定。委托人设计线性合约，即成功时向每个代理人支付固定金额。代理人的策略构成一个博弈，委托人目标是在纯纳什均衡下最大化自身期望收益。关键量是代理人的边际贡献，它决定了激励所需支付的最低金额。问题归结为寻找最优激励集合以最大化委托人效用。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文揭示了GS类内部精细的近似复杂性分层：对于OXS函数（GS的一个子类），最优合约问题是APX-完全的，排除了PTAS的存在；而对于加权拟阵秩函数（另一GS子类），则存在EPTAS，但不存在随机FPTAS；特别地，当拟阵为划分拟阵时，可达到FPTAS。此外，在更广的超函数类中，即使子模性不成立，单智能体情形仍可解，但在多智能体下却无法实现次指数近似。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过多种技术手段建立结果：对OXS的硬度证明基于Max-Cut问题的PTAS归约，利用匹配表示中边际贡献的全局依赖性制造难度；对WMRF的EPTAS则利用最优解可取为独立集的结构性质，将问题转化为预算拟阵独立集问题并调用其已知EPTAS；对无FPTAS的证明采用精确拟阵基问题的oracle下界构造间隙实例；对超函数的下界则结合Yao原理与隐藏集构造对抗性分布。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文的核心贡献在于揭示了子模性在多智能体合约中的关键作用，并展示了GS类内部不同子类的巨大差异，这依赖于特定结构如匹配或拟阵。虽然部分结果依赖强假设或oracle模型，但其精细分类和反例构造极具启发性。最值得阅读的是其清晰的问题界定、对复杂性层级的细致拆解以及多种归约与下界技术的综合运用，为后续研究提供了坚实基础。

papers.title: Does AI Help or Harm? Endogenous Information Acquisition with AI Advice
papers.titleZh: AI 有益还是有害？基于 AI 建议的内生信息获取
papers.abstract: AI advice increasingly enters human decision workflows before costly information acquisition and final action. This paper studies how such advice affects decision quality, measured by the gross utility of the final action. Advice shifts beliefs before the decision maker chooses an acquisition experiment with uniformly posterior-separable (UPS) costs. The analysis characterizes gross effects through the continuation gross value generated by net-optimal acquisition. Convexity of this value function is necessary and sufficient for every AI signal to weakly improve gross utility at every prior, while nonconvexity allows a binary signal to cause gross harm. The criterion gives tight state-space results. Every AI signal is weakly gross-improving in binary-state problems under arbitrary actions, payoffs, and UPS costs. A minimal three-state problem can generate gross harm through concentrated shutdown, where valuable acquisition stops. For classification problems with Shannon acquisition costs, the criterion becomes an active-set slope test. It guarantees weak gross improvement for homogeneous classification and all three-state weighted classification problems, while a minimal four-state failure arises from attention dilution, where acquisition shifts away from high-stake distinctions. Along a Blackwell-increasing mixture path, gross utility can first decrease and then increase. With endogenous interpretation, cheaper interpretation can reduce gross utility.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当人类在做决策前收到 AI 建议后，是否会因此改变后续的信息搜索行为，从而影响最终决策质量？现实中，医生看到算法风险评分后可能跳过进一步检查，这可能导致误判。现有研究多关注人类对 AI 的依赖偏差，而本文聚焦于 AI 建议如何通过改变理性人的信息获取策略，反而降低最终决策效果。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设定一个贝叶斯决策者，在行动前可进行有成本的信息采集。AI 建议作为外生信号更新其信念，之后她选择最优的信息采集策略以最大化净效用（决策收益减去信息成本）。信息成本采用均匀后验可分（UPS）形式，涵盖香农熵等常见测度。分析比较有无 AI 建议下的最终决策质量（即总效用，不含信息成本）。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现 AI 建议并不总是提升决策质量。关键在于‘延续性总价值函数’是否凸：若凸，则所有 AI 信号至少不会损害决策；若非凸，则存在有害建议。在二元状态下该函数恒凸，故 AI 总是有益；但在三状态及以上时，可能出现‘集中关闭’或‘注意力稀释’导致总效用下降。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者利用后验分裂几何与凹包（concavification）方法，将信息采集问题转化为信念空间上的优化。通过分析总价值函数的 Jensen 间隙来衡量 AI 建议的影响。核心技术是将净最优采集策略的产出视为信念的函数，并研究其凸性如何决定 AI 的作用方向，从而将复杂的动态决策简化为几何性质判断。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设决策者完全理性且能精确求解最优采集策略，忽略了认知限制与计算成本。结果高度依赖于价值函数的凸性，而该性质在复杂现实中未必成立。尽管如此，论文提供了理解 AI 干预后果的新框架，其核心洞见——AI 可能抑制高价值信息搜寻——对评估算法辅助系统极具启发价值。

papers.title: On the Power of Determinism in Multi-Item Auctions
papers.titleZh: 确定性在多物品拍卖中的力量
papers.abstract: We study the classical multi-item monopoly setting with a single additive buyer and $m$ heterogeneous items whose values are independent but not necessarily identically distributed. Optimal truthful auctions may be randomized and complicated. We analyze the approximation ratios of three simple deterministic auctions: selling all items separately, selling them as a single grand bundle, and choosing the better of the two. Our technical cornerstone is a nonlinear mathematical programming formulation of the worst-case approximation ratio of selling separately, in discrete auctions where values lie in the grid $\{0,1/K,2/K,\dots ,1\}$. For two iid items, we construct novel tight Lagrangian dual certificates that determine this ratio exactly for any discretization parameter $K$. Taking $K\to\infty$, we obtain the tight bound $1+W(1/e)\approx 1.278$ in the continuous-valued setting, where $W$ denotes the Lambert-W function, closing the $[1.278,1.368]$ gap from the work of Hart and Nisan [EC'12, JET 2017]. For $m\geq2$ independent items, a different dual construction gives an upper bound on the approximation ratio of selling separately in terms of basic statistics of the item values. Combining this bound with new inequalities relating optimal revenue (REV), separate-selling revenue (SREV), and grand-bundle revenue (BREV), we derive improved guarantees for all three auctions. Most notably, we prove \[REV\leq 3.5 \max\{SREV,BREV\},\] improving upon the $5.2$ factor of Ma and Simchi-Levi [AISTATS'21] and the $6$ factor of Babaioff, Immorlica, Lucier and Weinberg [FOCS'14, JACM 2020]. For iid items, we also prove $REV\leq 4.4534 BREV$.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么简单的确定性拍卖机制能在复杂环境中接近最优收益？传统多物品拍卖中，最优机制可能随机且难以实现，而实践中更倾向使用简单机制。本文聚焦于‘分别售卖’和‘捆绑销售’这两种直观策略，旨在精确量化它们在最坏情况下的近似能力，填补此前理论界限不紧的空白。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个卖家与单个加性买家交易 m 个异质物品的场景，买家对各物品的估值独立但不必同分布，且取值位于离散网格。研究对比三种确定性机制：单独出售每个物品、整体捆绑出售、或二者择优。目标是分析这些机制的期望收益与理论上最优（可能随机）机制收益之间的比值。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文最核心成果是闭合了两个同分布物品下‘分别售卖’机制的近似比长期存在的理论缺口，精确得出该比值为 1+W(1/e)≈1.278，其中 W 为 Lambert-W 函数。此外，对于一般独立物品，证明了最优收益至多是 max{SREV, BREV} 的 3.5 倍，显著改进了先前 5.2 或 6 的上界。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 技术核心在于构建了一个非线性数学规划来刻画‘分别售卖’的最坏情况，并通过精心设计的拉格朗日对偶方案进行分析。对于两物品情形，作者构造了紧致的对偶证书，从而实现了精确的比率计算。该方法将复杂的机制设计问题转化为可管理的优化问题，并利用对偶性提供上界证明。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文主要局限在于其紧致结果高度依赖于特定的离散化模型和对偶构造，尤其是两物品的精确界难以直接推广到更多物品。尽管如此，其价值在于提供了前所未有的精确分析，展示了离散化作为研究工具的力量，其对偶技术与核心思想对后续研究具有重要启发意义。

papers.title: Truthful-in-Expectation Mechanism with Constant Maximin-Share Guarantee
papers.titleZh: 具有常数最大最小份额保证的期望下真实性机制
papers.abstract: We study the truthful and fair allocation of indivisible goods to $n$ strategic agents with additive valuations. Babaioff, Feige, and Manaker Morag [FOCS 2026] gave a randomized mechanism that uses only the agents' rankings of the goods, is truthful in expectation (TIE), and guarantees every agent $1/(H_{n-1}+2)=Θ(1/\log n)$ of her maximin share (MMS) in every realized allocation, where $H_{n-1}$ is the $(n-1)$th harmonic number; this is nearly the best possible with rankings alone. They conjectured that cardinal information allows TIE mechanisms to achieve a constant ex-post MMS guarantee. We confirm this conjecture: our TIE mechanism guarantees every agent at least $1/7$ of her MMS in every realized allocation; moreover, the mechanism is ex-ante envy-free and can be implemented in polynomial time. Our mechanism has two key technical ingredients, both of which may be of independent interest. The first is a truthful fractional allocation rule specifying each agent's probability of receiving each good: it favors each agent on her top $n-1$ goods and reduces her probability of receiving a good for each other agent who also ranks it among her top $n-1$ goods. The second is the balanced edge coloring: we decompose these probabilities into equally likely matchings from agents to high-value goods, those that alone meet an agent's guarantee, and balance these matchings in a fine-grained way without changing any marginal probability, so that every agent who receives no high-value good can obtain sufficient value from the remaining goods without over-allocating any good.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 该研究旨在解决在战略环境下分配不可分割物品时如何同时保证公平性和真实性的问题。现有机制在仅使用序数信息时无法突破对数级的公平性保证，而作者关注是否利用基数效用信息可在保持期望下真实性的同时实现常数因子的最大最小份额（MMS）保证，填补了激励兼容与强公平性共存的理论空白。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑n个代理人对m个不可分割物品具有非负加法估值的情形。每个代理人的估值为其私有信息，机制只能基于报告的估值进行分配。目标是设计一个随机机制，在期望意义上激励代理人如实报告，并在每一次实际分配中保证每个代理人获得不低于其MMS固定比例的价值。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了首个在任意代理人数量下仍能实现常数MMS事后保证的期望下真实机制，解决了Babaioff等人提出的公开问题。机制不仅满足期望下的真实性与事前无嫉妒，还能在每次实现的分配中保证每个代理人至少获得其截断比例份额（TPS）的常数比例，从而也满足常数MMS保证。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心技术分为两步：首先设计一个基于‘顶部集合竞争’的诚实分数分配规则，赋予每个代理人在其高价值物品上的优势；其次通过‘平衡边着色’技术将分数分配分解为若干匹配，精细调控低价值物品的补偿分配，确保即使未分得高价值物品也能通过低价值捆绑达到价值下限，同时不超配任何物品。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 机制依赖于精确的基数估值报告，且构造过程较为复杂，可能影响实际部署。然而，其将分数机制与图论分解结合的技术路径极具启发性，尤其在处理事后公平与激励兼容的张力方面提供了新范式。最值得阅读的是其机制构造逻辑与平衡着色技术，以及对未来最优性分析的开放讨论。

papers.title: Manifold-Stable Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Flow matching (FM) learns generative dynamics through velocity regression. Geometric FM variants commonly assume a prior supported on the data manifold, requiring geometric knowledge that is often unavailable. Without such knowledge, low regression error alone does not guarantee manifold adherence. Adherence keeps generated samples within valid configurations and is empirically associated with better task performance. We introduce manifold-stable flow matching (MSFM), which can start from an arbitrary ambient prior, not necessarily supported on the manifold. Using tools from nonlinear dynamics, namely contraction theory, MSFM combines learned tangential transport with prescribed normal contraction. The construction uses analytical projectors for known manifolds and local affine proxies estimated by principal component analysis for unknown data geometry. By implementing contraction theory in both cases of known and unknown manifolds, we guarantee manifold invariance and transverse convergence to the manifold within a desired time window (e.g., one second). We derive a family of compatible probability paths and decompose the training loss into a learnable tangential term and a normal residual. An ellipse experiment attains a mean terminal off-manifold error of order $10^{-6}$. In Push-T robotic experiments, MSFM raises success from $74\%$ to $82\%$. In the Robomimic Square task, success increases from $60\%$ to $72\%$, while rotation-manifold deviation decreases from order $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-7}$. The MSFM terminal geometric errors are controlled by the chosen numerical tolerance. These results demonstrate stronger geometric adherence and higher observed task performance, supporting prescribed normal contraction as a complement to learned generative transport.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 生成模型常需在低维流形上生成有效样本，但传统流匹配仅通过速度回归无法保证轨迹始终贴近流形，尤其在流形未知或初始分布不在其上时。这导致生成结果可能偏离合法配置，影响下游任务性能。本文关注如何从任意初始分布出发，确保生成过程稳定收敛到目标流形，而不依赖后处理投影。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型输入为源噪声与目标数据点，输出为条件向量场，用于驱动微分方程生成样本。训练时采用分离式损失：网络仅学习切向运输速度，法向收缩由解析或局部PCA代理预设。推理时积分该混合场，评估指标包括终端几何误差与任务成功率，在椭圆采样、Push-T和Robomimic Square任务中对比传统流匹配。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出流形稳定流匹配（MSFM），通过显式设计法向收缩项，首次实现从任意环境先验到流形的有限时间收敛保证。实验显示终端离流形误差达10^-6量级，旋转偏差降低五个数量级，任务成功率显著提升。结果表明几何稳定性本身即可增强性能，无需更大模型或更多数据。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是将生成流分解为可学习的切向运输与预设的法向收缩。利用收缩理论构造法向反馈项，确保横向距离指数衰减。已知流形用解析投影算子，未知时用局部PCA构建仿射代理。损失被正交分解为切向拟合项与法向兼容残差，使训练目标清晰分离学习与稳定性机制。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论依赖于局部几何近似有效性，切换PCA代理时无全局最优性保证，且绝对成功率低于SOTA策略。但其价值在于揭示了几何稳定性对闭环性能的关键作用。最值得读的是问题设定与方法设计，尤其是如何将非线性控制系统理论融入生成建模框架。

papers.title: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
papers.titleZh: 世界动作模型为何能泛化？关于测试时未来建模的实证研究
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict the future alongside actions during \emph{training}. Due to the heavy computation cost of video denoising, whether the future must still be generated during \emph{inference} is disputed: Explicit WAMs denoise it into clean frames along with every action chunk, whereas Latent WAMs discard it entirely for acceleration. We find that latent WAMs, despite matching explicit ones on in-distribution tasks, fail to retain the generalization benefits that originally motivated WAMs. To demonstrate this, we evaluate generalization along three axes: \emph{environmental perturbation}, \emph{data efficiency}, and \emph{task generalization}. Controlled comparisons with a matched backbone, training data, and budget reveal consistent degradation across all three axes when the action expert no longer conditions on future representations. Further analysis shows that the gap arises almost entirely from the first denoising step: the benefit comes from \emph{preparing} the future, not \emph{generating} it. We therefore propose \textbf{Simple-WAM}, which simplifies future modeling into a single forward pass of fully noised video tokens and adapts the training-time noise schedule to this inference behavior. Across simulation and real-world tasks, Simple-WAM achieves the best of both worlds, leading explicit WAMs in generalization performance with efficiency comparable to Latent WAMs. Project Page: \href{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web/}{\textcolor{panton}{\texttt{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web}}}

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合预测视觉未来和动作来提升机器人策略的泛化能力，但其高昂的视频生成成本限制了实时控制。当前存在争议：未来建模是否必须在推理时执行？显式WAM虽能生成清晰未来帧，但效率低；隐式WAM舍弃未来生成以加速，却可能牺牲泛化。本文核心问题是：推理阶段的未来建模究竟起什么作用，能否在保持高效的同时保留其泛化优势？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究聚焦于语言条件下的视觉运动控制任务，输入为观测图像、指令和状态，输出为动作序列。模型由视频专家和动作专家组成，训练时共同学习从噪声中恢复未来帧并预测动作。关键比较在于推理时是否保留未来视频标记及其处理方式。评估涵盖三个维度：环境扰动下的鲁棒性、少量示范的数据效率、以及未见任务的任务泛化，确保结论不局限于标准测试性能。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现，尽管隐式WAM在标准任务上表现接近显式WAM，但在三项泛化指标上显著落后，说明未来建模不仅是训练目标，更是推理时的关键组件。更重要的是，仅需一次对完全加噪未来帧的前向传播即可恢复大部分泛化能力。基于此，Simple-WAM在几乎不增加延迟的情况下超越显式WAM的泛化性能，实现了效率与能力的统一，挑战了‘泛化必牺牲速度’的传统认知。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过控制变量实验揭示机制：固定主干、数据和预算，仅改变推理时对未来标记的使用方式。他们逐步减少去噪步数，发现首步即带来最大收益。Simple-WAM据此简化设计——仅在T=1处输入纯噪声未来帧，并调整训练时的噪声调度以匹配该行为。这种方法无需新模块，仅修改注意力掩码和采样策略，便使视频分支仅运行一次，大幅降低计算开销。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论基于5B级视频主干且未结合具身预训练，更大规模或不同架构下是否成立尚待验证。此外，方法依赖预训练视频模型对噪声输入的敏感性，若主干更换可能影响效果。最值得阅读的是其严谨的实验设计与反直觉发现：泛化源于‘准备未来’而非‘生成未来’。这对构建高效通用智能体提供了新思路，尤其适合高频率控制场景。

papers.title: RoGSW4RLD: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Lifting for Robot World Model Rollouts
papers.titleZh: RoGSW4RLD: 前馈式 4D 高斯提升用于机器人世界模型 rollout
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned video world models predict future robot interactions from multiple cameras, yet their outputs remain disparate video collections rather than a shared metric scene queryable across viewpoints and time. While existing 4D reconstruction methods offer a path to spatialize these predictions, independently reconstructing and merging each camera stream fails to enforce cross-view consistency. This limitation is particularly detrimental when combining moving robot-mounted cameras with fixed external views. To address this, we introduce RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD directly reconstructs the visual future generated by existing world models. Its core innovation is a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 jointly forms the metric 4D field by fusing cross-view evidence with robot-specific articulated geometry and kinematics, while Stage 2 refines the field's geometry and appearance while strictly preserving the initial temporal displacements. Evaluated on 256 held-out DROID episodes, RoGSW4RLD significantly outperforms camera-wise reconstruction with calibrated merging, improving novel-view PSNR by 2.15 dB, reducing depth AbsRel by 47%, and lowering robot displacement error by 61%. These robust gains extend to action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, demonstrating that predicted video futures can be successfully translated into consistent, spatially queryable 4D metric representations.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有视频世界模型虽能预测多视角机器人交互，但输出仍是分离的视频流，缺乏统一的、可跨视角和时间查询的度量空间场景。独立重建各相机流再合并的方法因缺少跨视图一致性约束，尤其在移动腕部相机与固定外部相机共存时，易产生几何冲突与运动错位。本文旨在解决如何从同步多视图 rollout 中联合构建一致的时空连贯场景。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型接收多视角同步视频作为输入，在共享机器人坐标系下重建一个时间可查询的度量级 4D 高斯场。训练使用 DROID 数据集的 256 个未见片段，评估涵盖源视图与新视图渲染质量、度量深度精度及机器人运动误差。对比基线为独立重建后校准合并的方法，评价指标包括 PSNR、AbsRel 和机器人位移误差。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出 RoGSW4RLD，显著提升了新视图渲染（PSNR 提升 2.15 dB）、度量深度（AbsRel 降低 47%）和机器人运动精度（位移误差减少 61%）。其核心贡献在于将机器人运动学与关节几何融入联合提升过程，实现了比后处理对齐更优的空间与时间一致性，验证了生成式 rollout 可被转化为可靠的空间可查询表示。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法采用两阶段前馈架构：第一阶段融合多视角观测与机器人网格锚定、正向运动学引导的形变，联合构建初始度量 4D 场；第二阶段通过渲染反馈进行位移保持的精细化修正，确保时间动态不变。关键创新在于利用机器人先验在重建初期即建立跨视图一致性，而非依赖后期对齐。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限包括依赖精确标定、已知机器人几何与轨迹，且未测试更长时序或非标定设置。评估结合了生成与重建误差，难以完全剥离。最值得阅读的是其系统设计思想——如何将物理先验嵌入生成式模型输出的结构化解码过程，为构建具身智能体的空间认知提供了新路径。

papers.title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.

papers.title: Do Not Cut When Uncertain: Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads for VLA Policies in Robotic Harvesting
papers.titleZh: SeeReach-VLA: 面向遮挡环境下葡萄园收获的感知意识边缘部署
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained with behavior cloning or flow matching are optimized to output an action trajectory, but they cannot express "I don't know" or "I should not act." In robotic harvesting, occlusion makes single-frame decisions fundamentally ambiguous: identical pixels can correspond either to a cuttable stem or to no stem at all. Existing VLAs are forced to commit, leading to high-confidence errors with irreversible consequences. We argue that the failure mode of a VLA is determined not by backbone scale but by its output interface. We propose Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads (RCDH), a typed, rejectable, and calibrated output interface that can be attached to a frozen VLA backbone without retraining or new features. RCDH introduces (i) a decision schema with explicit rejection and ordered, conditional decomposition, and (ii) a calibration procedure for risk-aware abstention. We evaluate RCDH on a robotic harvesting platform with controllable leaf occlusion, comparing generative, enumerated, calibrated, and rejectable interfaces. We show that replacing only the output head restores out-of-distribution usability under occlusion while preserving in-distribution performance. We further test whether the ordering of the rejection space is critical. Our results suggest that the right to refuse, rather than a larger model, is the missing interface for reliable manipulation under uncertainty.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在藤架作物采摘中，机器人常面临目标果梗被叶片遮挡的问题。传统视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型假设靠近目标总有益，但在实际几何结构下，接近可能反而恶化可见性。现有方法无法识别这种方向性影响，导致决策失误，尤其是在关键距离附近存在不可见的不连续点，构成结构性失效风险。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究在RGB-D观测和语言指令下，四足机器人及其机械臂的动作决策问题。输入为多模态感知数据，输出为移动基座、伸展手臂或后退观察等操作。评估基于采摘成功率与边缘设备推理延迟的帕累托前沿，在仿真与真实多视角数据上测试，并使用Jetson Orin NX进行边缘部署验证。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出首个显式学习‘接近效应符号’的VLA架构，通过离散分类头判断接近是否改善可视性，并以此门控动作生成。结合边界聚焦采样策略，在关键距离附近显著提升成功率，同时保持低延迟。实验证明该设计优于标准及主动视觉VLA基线，验证了符号感知对可靠决策的价值。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是将接近效应的符号作为辅助分类任务，训练一个三类分类头（有益/有害/模糊），其输出调制动作解码器对前进动作的偏好。训练时采用基于解析模型的边界聚焦采样，集中于符号模糊带；部署时拆分为低频符号判断与高频动作生成双分支，兼顾精度与实时性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 主要局限在于仿真主导评估，真实田间动态未完全覆盖，且符号标签依赖重建数据，存在误差传播风险。跨品种迁移仅在仿真中验证。尽管如此，论文最值得读的是其问题抽象方式——将感知不确定性转化为可学习的离散决策，为遮挡下的机器人行为提供了新范式。
